fixed.title: Replay observers ignore live mode, making verified findings unreachable on live sites
fixed.fix: Threaded gate.liveMode into both createObserver calls (replay-before and replay-after). observe() now runs assertAllowedUrl with the run's live-mode flag, so an authorized public origin passes the GQ-001 allowlist check during replay observation; loopback-only remains the default when live mode is off.
